### Differences between cloud.ragflow.io and a locally deployed open-source RAGFlow service? 

cloud.ragflow.io demonstrates the capabilities of RAGFlow Enterprise. Its DeepDoc models are pre-trained using proprietary data and it offers much more sophisticated team permission controls. Essentially, cloud.ragflow.io serves as a preview of RAGFlow's forthcoming SaaS (Software as a Service) offering.

You can deploy an open-source RAGFlow service and call it from a Python client or through RESTful APIs. However, this is not supported on cloud.ragflow.io.

### Get a `Request error 404: undefined` when upgrading to v0.26.4 

To resolve this issue, do either of the following:

* Pull the latest source code from the [main branch](https://github.com/infiniflow/ragflow) , then pull and start the v0.26.4 image.
* Update `RAGFLOW_IMAGE` from `infiniflow/ragflow:latest` to `infiniflow/ragflow:v0.26.4` in the [.env file](https://github.com/infiniflow/ragflow/blob/main/docker/.env) , then restart the service.

### How to build the RAGFlow image from scratch? 

See Build a RAGFlow Docker image .

### Cannot access <https://huggingface.co> 

A locally deployed RAGFlow downloads OCR models from [Huggingface website](https://huggingface.co) by default. If your machine is unable to access this site, the following error occurs and PDF parsing fails:

```
FileNotFoundError: [Errno 2] No such file or directory: '/root/.cache/huggingface/hub/models--InfiniFlow--deepdoc/snapshots/be0c1e50eef6047b412d1800aa89aba4d275f997/ocr.res'
```

### How to tune batch size for document parsing and embedding? 

You can control the batch size for document parsing and embedding by setting the environment variables `DOC_BULK_SIZE` and `EMBEDDING_BATCH_SIZE` . Increasing these values may improve throughput for large-scale data processing, but will also increase memory usage. Adjust them according to your hardware resources.

### How to use MinerU to parse PDF documents? 

From v0.22.0 onwards, RAGFlow includes MinerU (≥ 2.6.3) as an optional PDF parser of multiple backends. Please note that RAGFlow acts only as a _remote client_ for MinerU, calling the MinerU API to parse PDFs and reading the returned files. To use this feature:

1.
Prepare a reachable MinerU API service (FastAPI server).
2. In the **.env** file or from the **Model providers** page in the UI, configure RAGFlow as a remote client to MinerU:
   
    + `MINERU_APISERVER` : The MinerU API endpoint (e.g., `http://mineru-host:8886` ).
    + `MINERU_BACKEND` : The MinerU backend:
         
        - `"pipeline"` (default)
        - `"vlm-http-client"`
        - `"vlm-transformers"`
        - `"vlm-vllm-engine"`
        - `"vlm-mlx-engine"`
        - `"vlm-vllm-async-engine"`
        - `"vlm-lmdeploy-engine"` .
    + `MINERU_SERVER_URL` : (optional) The downstream vLLM HTTP server (e.g., `http://vllm-host:30000` ). Applicable when `MINERU_BACKEND` is set to `"vlm-http-client"` .
    + `MINERU_OUTPUT_DIR` : (optional) The local directory for holding the outputs of the MinerU API service (zip/JSON) before ingestion.
    + `MINERU_DELETE_OUTPUT` : Whether to delete temporary output when a temporary directory is used:
         
        - `1` : Delete.
- `0` : Retain.
3. In the web UI, navigate to your dataset's **Configuration** page and find the **Ingestion pipeline** section:
   
    + If you decide to use a chunking method from the **Built-in** dropdown, ensure it supports PDF parsing, then select **MinerU** from the **PDF parser** dropdown.
    + If you use a custom ingestion pipeline instead, select **MinerU** in the **PDF parser** section of the **Parser** component.

note

All MinerU environment variables are optional. When set, these values are used to auto-provision a MinerU OCR model for the tenant on first use. To avoid auto-provisioning, skip the environment variable settings and only configure MinerU from the **Model providers** page in the UI.

WARNING

Third-party visual models are marked **Experimental** , because we have not fully tested these models for the aforementioned data extraction tasks.

* * *

### How to configure MinerU-specific settings?
The table below summarizes the most frequently used MinerU environment variables for remote MinerU:

|Environment variable |Description |Default |Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
|`MINERU_APISERVER` |URL of the MinerU API service |_unset_ |`MINERU_APISERVER=http://your-mineru-server:8886` |
|`MINERU_BACKEND` |MinerU parsing backend |`pipeline` |`MINERU_BACKEND=pipeline|vlm-transformers|vlm-vllm-engine|vlm-mlx-engine|vlm-vllm-async-engine|vlm-http-client` |
|`MINERU_SERVER_URL` |URL of remote vLLM server (for `vlm-http-client` ) |_unset_ |`MINERU_SERVER_URL=http://your-vllm-server-ip:30000` |
|`MINERU_OUTPUT_DIR` |Directory for MinerU output files |System-defined temporary directory |`MINERU_OUTPUT_DIR=/home/ragflow/mineru/output` |
|`MINERU_DELETE_OUTPUT` |Whether to delete MinerU output directory when a temp dir is used |`1` (delete temp output) |`MINERU_DELETE_OUTPUT=0` |

1. Set `MINERU_APISERVER` to point RAGFlow to your MinerU API server.
2.
Set `MINERU_BACKEND` to specify a parsing backend.
3. If using the `"vlm-http-client"` backend, set `MINERU_SERVER_URL` to your vLLM server's URL. MinerU API expects `backend=vlm-http-client` and `server_url=http://<server>:30000` in the request body.
4. Set `MINERU_OUTPUT_DIR` to specify where RAGFlow stores MinerU API output; otherwise, a system temp directory is used.
5. Set `MINERU_DELETE_OUTPUT` to `0` to keep MinerU's temp output (useful for debugging).

NOTE

For information about other environment variables natively supported by MinerU, see [here](https://opendatalab.github.io/MinerU/usage/cli_tools/) .

* * *

### How to use MinerU with a vLLM server for document parsing? 

RAGFlow supports MinerU's `vlm-http-client` backend, enabling you to delegate document parsing tasks to a remote vLLM server while calling MinerU via HTTP. To configure:

1. Ensure a MinerU API service is reachable (for example `http://mineru-host:8886` ).
2.
Set up or point to a vLLM HTTP server (for example `http://vllm-host:30000` ).
3. Configure the following in your **docker/.env** file (or your shell if running from source):
   
    + `MINERU_APISERVER=http://mineru-host:8886`
    + `MINERU_BACKEND="vlm-http-client"`
    + `MINERU_SERVER_URL="http://vllm-host:30000"` MinerU API calls expect `backend=vlm-http-client` and `server_url=http://<server>:30000` in the request body.
4. Configure `MINERU_OUTPUT_DIR` / `MINERU_DELETE_OUTPUT` as desired to manage the returned zip/JSON before ingestion.

NOTE

When using the `vlm-http-client` backend, the RAGFlow server requires no GPU, only network connectivity. This enables cost-effective distributed deployment with multiple RAGFlow instances sharing one remote vLLM server.

Best for Python

## Skill Installation

MinerU Document Extractor Skill can be installed in Openclaw and other Agent tools, as well as Claude Code.

### Installation Methods

Openclaw Manual Recommended Openclaw Auto Claude Code

Download the zip file from the link below, extract it, drag it into the Agent dialog, and say the following to the Agent:

[Download zip file](https://webpub.shlab.tech/MinerU/static/assets/skill.zip)

prompt

```
Extract skill.md from skill.zip and install the MinerU Skill
```

## MCP Server

MinerU Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server: the bridge between LLM clients and MinerU, enabling parameterized, structured document parsing.

### Integration Examples

Remote Local

bash

```
# Get your token at https://mineru.net/apiManage/docs
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "mineru": {
      "type": "streamableHttp",
      "url": "https://mcp.mineru.net/mcp",
      "env": {
        "MINERU_API_TOKEN": "your token"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## CLI/SDK
Ready-to-run commands to quickly integrate MinerU document parsing into your development environment.

## Open API CLI

Quickly call MinerU Open API via command line, supporting file parsing, format conversion and other core features.

Mac & Linux Windows

Install MinerU CLI

```
curl -fsSL https://cdn-mineru.openxlab.org.cn/open-api-cli/install.sh | sh
```

Common Parsing Commands

```
# Parse PDF to Markdown
mineru-open-api extract https://cdn-mineru.openxlab.org.cn/demo/example.pdf

# Batch parse
mineru-open-api extract --list files.txt -o ./results/
```

## Open API

Call MinerU parsing service directly via HTTP API, suitable for integration into your own systems or workflows.

Python JavaScript / TypeScript GO

SDK Quick Start

```
from mineru import MinerU

# No token needed for Flash Mode
client = MinerU()
result = client.flash_extract("https://cdn-mineru.openxlab.org.cn/demo/example.pdf")
print(result.markdown)

# Get your free token from https://mineru.net
client = MinerU("your-api-token")
result = client.extract("https://cdn-mineru.openxlab.org.cn/demo/example.pdf")
print(result.markdown)
print(result.images) # Access extracted images
```

## RAG Framework Integration

Seamlessly integrate with LangChain, Dify, RAGFlow, Flowise and other mainstream frameworks — from document parsing to knowledge base construction in one stop.

LangChain logo

### LangChain

Official Recommended Loader

Deeply integrated into the LangChain ecosystem as a Loader, uniformly converting various external data sources (such as PDF) into LangChain-processable Document format. Combined with MarkdownHeaderTextSplitter for intelligent heading-level chunking, completely eliminating semantic fragmentation from hard character-count splitting.

`from langchain_mineru import MinerULoader
loader = MinerULoader(source="demo.pdf")
docs = loader.load()
print(docs[0].page_content[:500])
print(docs[0].metadata)`

[MinerU-Ecosystem](https://github.
com/opendatalab/MinerU-Ecosystem/tree/main/langchain_mineru)

Dify logo

### Dify

Official Plugin Integration

Official recommended plugin helping developers quickly build RAG applications based on high-fidelity structured documents. Supports both MinerU official API and local deployment modes, parsing PDF, DOC, PPT, Excel, images and other formats, outputting Markdown, JSON, HTML, LaTeX and more.

[MinerU Official Plugin](https://github.com/langgenius/dify-official-plugins/tree/main/tools/mineru)

RAGFlow logo

### RAGFlow

Built-in Engine

Built-in preprocessing engine tackling multimodal document chunking challenges to ensure RAG effectiveness. MinerU has been built-in as an optional PDF parser since v0.22.0, supporting pipeline, VLM and other backend modes.

[Parsing Configuration](https://opendatalab.github.io/MinerU/zh/usage/plugin/RagFlow/)

Flowise logo

### Flowise

Zero-code Drag & Drop

...

mineru import MinerUReader

reader = MinerUReader()
documents = reader.load_data(
    "https://cdn-mineru.openxlab.org.cn/demo/example.pdf"
)
print(documents[0].text)
```

[MinerU Ecosystem](https://github.com/opendatalab/MinerU-Ecosystem/tree/main/llama-index-readers-mineru)

## Apps & Workflows

Deep integration with popular platforms via plugins, nodes, or built-in engines — let MinerU fit into your productivity toolchain.

Coze logo

### Coze

Official Plugin + Agent

Seamlessly integrated into AI agents via official plugin, giving LLMs the ability to directly read complex layout documents. Supports multi-format parsing of PDF, images, web pages, and one-click structured knowledge generation.

[MinerU Official Plugin](https://www.coze.cn/store/plugin/7527957359730360354) [Agent](https://www.coze.cn/store/agent/7530945296076062746)

[View Guide](https://opendatalab.github.io/MinerU/zh/usage/plugin/Coze/)

n8n logo

### n8n

Automation Workflow Node
Provides dedicated automation nodes for unattended high-frequency workflows. Supports batch document processing and login-free invocation, suitable for enterprise-level document digitalization automation pipelines.

[MinerU Official Plugin](https://www.npmjs.com/package/n8n-nodes-mineru)

[View Guide](https://opendatalab.github.io/MinerU/zh/usage/plugin/n8n/)

FastGPT logo

### FastGPT

Native Knowledge Base Integration

Natively integrated into the platform toolchain, providing clean Markdown text for knowledge bases, significantly improving retrieval precision and Q&A quality. Supports automatic document chunking and index building.

[MinerU Official Plugin](https://cloud.fastgpt.io/dashboard/systemPlugin?type=tools)

[View Guide](https://opendatalab.github.io/MinerU/zh/usage/plugin/FastGPT/)

DingTalk logo

### DingTalk

Enterprise Document Digitalization
Enterprise-level parsing tool built on MinerU, providing high-precision multimodal document digitalization and structuring solutions. Supports intelligent extraction of contracts, invoices, reports and other enterprise documents.

[View Guide](https://opendatalab.github.io/MinerU/zh/usage/plugin/DingTalk/)

Cherry Studio logo

### Cherry Studio

LLM Conversation Enhancement

Deep integration with LLM conversational interaction, precisely extracting charts and formulas, eliminating AI hallucinations on complex data. Supports structured parsing and knowledge Q&A for papers and technical documents.

[View Guide](https://opendatalab.github.io/MinerU/zh/usage/plugin/Cherry_Studio/)

Hejing Science Platform logo

## Developer FAQ

Frequently asked questions to help you quickly understand MinerU's integration methods, billing rules, and technical capabilities.
### Agent Integration & Billing

Do I need to register an account for Agents to use MinerU?

No. We provide a "login-free flash mode" by default. Agents only need to carry a unique Device-ID generated on the client side, and they can get 10,000 free parsing pages per day, with ultra-fast speed, ready to use out of the box.

How do I switch to the full version that supports complex formulas and tables?

When integrating a Skill, select the high-precision parsing channel and pass in your API Key (obtained from the console) to seamlessly switch to high-precision mode, with structured output of clean Markdown and LaTeX formulas.

How are quotas deducted for web page (URL) parsing and file parsing?

Quotas are counted by page, with less than one page counting as one page. For web link (URL) extraction, each successful parse consumes 1 free page quota, which automatically resets at UTC 0:00.
